## Main entry point

| | |
|---|---|
| [`goAquaFlux()`](goAquaFlux.qmd) | Partition aquatic GHG fluxes into diffusive and ebullitive components across many incubations. |

## Components

| | |
|---|---|
| [`find.bubbles()`](find.bubbles.qmd) | Detect ebullition events as abrupt steps in a concentration series. |
| [`goAquaFlux.diffusive()`](goAquaFlux.diffusive.qmd) | Diffusive flux on a bubble-free window, via goFlux's LM/HM models. |
| [`goAquaFlux.ebullition()`](goAquaFlux.ebullition.qmd) | Ebullitive flux from detected bubble magnitudes. |
| [`goAquaFlux.total()`](goAquaFlux.total.qmd) | Combine components with error propagation and consistency checks. |
